scientific_question: Can a compact hidden-side Givens chart recover task-enriched directions when its discrete connectivity and angles are selected causally from the exact current coherent Muon update instead of fixed random or activation-only axes?
hypothesis: The dense c_proj path lies predominantly on a hidden-side orthogonal orbit, but prior compact charts failed because their axes were task-independent. Pairing hidden channels by the exact current identity-angle Muon coordinate gradient should retain materially more of the causal dense update and its future-chord alignment than equal-size random connectivity.

causal_protocol.connectivity_score: absolute exact identity-angle derivative inner product |<W_i,D_j>-<W_j,D_i>| using the coherent applied dense-Muon direction D at the phase start
causal_protocol.connectivity: greedy unique-edge perfect matchings; integer pairings only
causal_protocol.angle_fit_target: the exact current scheduled dense-Muon update lr*D
causal_protocol.future_information_policy: the future phase chord is never used to select connectivity or fit angles; it is used only after fitting to score causal recovery
causal_protocol.random_control: same coordinate count and angle-fit protocol with deterministic random perfect matchings

decision_rule.pass: promote only to an all-20-cell no-update oracle, not directly to language-model training
decision_rule.fail: reject sparse Muon-matched pair rewiring and do not implement a causal training structure

execution_policy: Run directly in the foreground on one idle Y400 GPU and poll to exit. Do not use a watchdog, callback, queue worker, heartbeat, or PRO6.
